Ruby open source: who builds it

A snapshot of Ruby's open-source engine in 2026. We scanned 3,914 repositories where Ruby is the dominant language and ranked every 2026 contributor by their Ruby-first commits, plus the top-starred, actively-maintained projects. A companion to the discoverability scorecard.

Where someone also has non-Ruby-first commits, the “N total” subline shows the larger figure.
